name: storygoeslikethis
title: the story goes like this
blurb: a browser stage production of norvidstudies.substack.com's 'the story goes like this' anthology — fourteen internet posters (@abelian_soup, @croissanthology, @lion_tender, and eleven more), each performed live in a distinct synthesized voice. asked for by @words.bsky.social as an 'ffmpeg movie' with voice synthesis; no ffmpeg or Workers AI ran — it's Web Speech, staged, plus a tab-capture recorder so you can save your own cut as a real video file.
